question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Noble
solution:
The correct answer is '**Dignified**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Noble**' is '**Dignified**'.
 
• **Noble**: honest; full of courage and care for others. (ईमानदार; साहसी और परोपकारी)
 
 
• *Example: a **noble** leader...*
 
 
 
• **Dignified**: behaving in a calm, serious way that makes other people respect you. (गरिमामय, मान-मर्यादापूर्ण, शालीन)
 
 
• *Example: dignified **behaviour**...*

 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__** *Dignified.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Poor**: not having enough money to have a comfortable life. (आरामदायक जीवन के लिए पर्याप्त धन का अभाव; ग़रीब, निर्धन)
 
• **Ordinary**: normal; not unusual or different from others. (साधारण; अन्‍यों से असामान्‍य या अलग नहीं, अन्‍यों के समान)
 
• **Normal**: typical, usual or ordinary; what you expect. (प्रतिनिधिक, सामान्‍य या साधारण, औसत; जिसकी आशा हो, प्रत्‍याशित)
